en.headline: Housing Authority begins HOS 2025 flat selection on 21 October
en.dek: Nearly 7,000 new flats across five projects in Kai Tak, Kam Tin, Tseung Kwan O, Ping Shan and Tung Chung will be offered at 70 per cent of assessed market value.
body: The Hong Kong Housing Authority will start flat selection for the Sale of Home Ownership Scheme Flats 2025 on 21 October.

Eligible applicants will be invited in batches, according to priority by application category, to the authority’s customer service centre in Lok Fu. The sale covers five new developments providing nearly 7,000 flats with saleable areas ranging from about 26.1 to 52 square metres. Selling prices run from about HK$1.5 million to about HK$4.8 million, set at a 30 per cent discount from assessed market values.

Quotas have been reserved for families joining the Priority Scheme for Families with Elderly Members and the Priority Scheme for Families with Newborns, as well as for one-person applicants. Tenants affected by announced public-rental clearance plans who opt to buy instead of rehousing will also receive priority.
The authority said the exercise continues its efforts to help public-housing tenants and other eligible households move up the housing ladder.

zh.headline: 房委會居屋2025下周三開始選樓 推近7000個單位
zh.dek: 五個新項目位於啟德、錦田、將軍澳、屏山及東涌，以評定市值七折發售，售價約150萬至480萬元。
body: 香港房屋委員會「出售居者有其屋計劃單位2025」將於10月21日開始選樓。
合資格申請者將按申請類別的優先次序分批獲邀前往樂富房委會客戶服務中心選購。計劃推售五個新發展項目，提供接近7000個單位，實用面積約26.1至52平方米。售價約150萬至480萬港元，以評定市值折減30%定價。
房委會已為參加「家有長者優先選樓計劃」及「家有初生優先選樓計劃」的家庭，以及一人申請者預留配額。受已公布公屋清拆計劃影響的租戶，如選擇購買資助出售單位代替入住公屋，亦可優先選樓。
房委會表示，是次推售繼續協助公屋租戶及其他合資格家庭循置業階梯向上流動。
